patterns.note: Full-width hero sections featuring large, dynamic product imagery or video, followed by a grid of product cards or feature blocks.
A clear typographic hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings for impact, supported by clean, readable sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
A restrained, high-contrast palette of black, white, and various greys, punctuated by a vibrant green for all primary calls-to-action.

The main navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid black background as it becomes sticky. The hero background image/video also exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text.

Each major product category or feature (e.g., 'v16 piston', 'supersonic', 'purifier') is introduced with its own dedicated hero-like section, complete with a prominent product shot, headline, and call-to-action.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar uses a CSS keyframe animation or transition to smoothly change its height and background color from transparent to solid black as the user scrolls, making it sticky. The hero section employs a video background that plays automatically, and a subtle parallax effect is achieved by having the background image scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content.

Product cards and content blocks are arranged in responsive grids, maintaining consistent padding and alignment. Calls-to-action are consistently styled with a bright green background and white text, providing clear visual cues across the site.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for product names and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., buttons, product cards have a very slight rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between major sections, with a more compact grid for product listings.

standout: This site stands out with its sophisticated use of high-quality product photography and video as hero elements, creating an immediate sense of luxury and innovation. The design's strength lies in its ability to present complex products with a clean, editorial aesthetic, making the technology feel aspirational rather than purely functional. The consistent, vibrant green CTA against a largely monochrome background is a powerful and effective branding element.
